statement.text:
A group Γ is said to have Property Pnai if, for any finite subset F of Γ \ {1},
there exists an element y0 ∈ Γ of infinite order such that, for each x ∈ F , the canonical
epimorphism from the free product ⟨x⟩ ∗ ⟨y0 ⟩ onto the subgroup ⟨x, y0 ⟩ of Γ generated
by x and y0 is an isomorphism. For n ∈ {2, 3, . . .}, does P SLn (Z) have Property
Pnai ? More generally, if Γ is a lattice in a connected real Lie group G which is simple
and with centre reduced to {1}, does Γ have Property Pnai ?
   Answers are known to be “yes” if n = 2, and more generally if G has real rank 1
(M. Bekka, M. Cowling, P. de la Harpe, Publ. Math. IHES, 80 (1994), 117–134).
   Comments of 2018: Property Pnai has been established for relatively hyperbolic
groups (G. Arzhantseva, A. Minasyan, J. Funct. Anal., 243, no. 1 (2007), 345–351)
and for groups acting on CAT(0) cube complexes with appropriate conditions (A. Kar,
M. Sageev, Comment. Math. Helv., 91 (2016), 543–561). Some progress has been
made in the preprint (T. Poznansky, http://arxiv.org/abs/0812.2486).
                                                                                     P. de la Harpe
